domains.label: Demographics
domains.description: Basic characteristics of the cohort member and the people around them.

topics.label: Age
topics.description: Age or date of birth, of the cohort member or anyone else.

topics.label: Sex and gender
topics.description: Sex or gender, of the cohort member or anyone else.

topics.label: Ethnic group
topics.description: Ethnicity, race, national identity.

topics.label: Place of birth
topics.description: Country or place of birth, migration background.

topics.label: Languages spoken
topics.description: Languages spoken at home or known; English as an additional language.

topics.label: Religion
topics.description: Religious affiliation, belief and practice.

topics.label: Location and geography
topics.description: Country, region, local authority, urban/rural, geographic codes.

domains.label: Housing and local environment
domains.description: The home, the neighbourhood and moving between them.

topics.label: Housing
topics.description: Tenure, dwelling type, rooms, housing costs, conditions, amenities, homelessness.

topics.label: Neighbourhood
topics.description: Local area, its facilities, safety and deprivation (e.g. IMD).

topics.label: Travel and transport
topics.description: Commuting, car access, journeys to school or work.

topics.label: Environmental exposure
topics.description: Pollution, noise, damp, second-hand smoke and similar exposures.

topics.label: Residential mobility
topics.description: Moving home, number of addresses, housing histories.

topics.label: General health
topics.description: Self-rated health, longstanding illness, limiting conditions.

topics.label: Cardiovascular system
topics.description: Heart disease, blood pressure, circulation.

topics.label: Musculoskeletal system
topics.description: Bones, joints, muscles, back pain, arthritis.

topics.label: Respiratory system
topics.description: Asthma, wheeze, bronchitis, lung function.

topics.label: Nervous system
topics.description: Epilepsy, migraine, neurological conditions.

topics.label: Digestive system
topics.description: Stomach, bowel and liver conditions.

topics.label: Urogenital system
topics.description: Kidney, bladder, bedwetting, urinary conditions.

topics.label: Endocrine system
topics.description: Diabetes, thyroid, hormonal conditions.

topics.label: Blood and immune system
topics.description: Anaemia, blood disorders, immune conditions.

topics.label: Hearing, vision and speech
topics.description: Eyesight, hearing, audiometry, speech problems.

topics.label: Oral and dental health
topics.description: Teeth, dental visits and treatment.

topics.label: Skin conditions
topics.description: Eczema and other skin conditions.

topics.label: Congenital conditions
topics.description: Congenital malformations and conditions present at birth.

topics.label: Cancer
topics.description: Cancer diagnosis and treatment.

topics.label: Mortality
topics.description: Death of the cohort member or others, causes of death.

topics.label: Reproductive health
topics.description: Fertility, contraception, infertility, reproductive conditions.

topics.label: Women's health
topics.description: Menstruation, menopause, gynaecological health.

topics.label: Accidents and injuries
topics.description: Accidents, injuries, poisonings, burns.

topics.label: Allergies
topics.description: Allergies and hay fever.

topics.label: Infections
topics.description: Infectious diseases, including Covid-19 infection.

topics.label: Anthropometry
topics.description: Height, weight, BMI, waist, body measurements.

topics.label: Physical characteristics
topics.description: Handedness, puberty, appearance and other physical traits.

topics.label: Physical functioning
topics.description: Mobility, grip strength, disability, difficulty with daily activities.

domains.label: Mental health and mental processes
domains.description: Mental health, wellbeing, personality and cognition.

topics.label: Mental health conditions
topics.description: Depression, anxiety, psychological distress (e.g. Malaise, GHQ, Kessler), self-harm, diagnosed mental illness.

topics.label: Personality and temperament
topics.description: Personality traits, temperament, locus of control, self-esteem.

topics.label: Wellbeing
topics.description: Life satisfaction, happiness, loneliness, quality of life.

topics.label: Emotions and behaviour
topics.description: Emotional and behavioural difficulties (e.g. Rutter, SDQ), feelings, anger, worry.

topics.label: Cognitive function
topics.description: Tests and measures of cognition, memory, reasoning, attention.

domains.label: Health care
domains.description: Use of health services and treatment.

topics.label: Health services use
topics.description: GP visits, consultations, contact with health professionals.

topics.label: Hospital admissions
topics.description: Hospital stays, A&E, operations.

topics.label: Immunisations
topics.description: Vaccinations, including Covid-19 vaccination.

topics.label: Medications
topics.description: Prescribed and over-the-counter medicines.

topics.label: Complementary therapies
topics.description: Alternative and complementary treatments.

topics.label: Health insurance
topics.description: Private medical insurance.

topics.label: Diet and nutrition
topics.description: Food eaten, meals, nutrient intake, dieting.

topics.label: Physical activity
topics.description: Exercise, sport, sedentary time, accelerometry.

topics.label: Sleep
topics.description: Sleep duration, quality, problems.

topics.label: Smoking
topics.description: Tobacco and e-cigarette use.

topics.label: Alcohol consumption
topics.description: Drinking frequency, amount, problem drinking (e.g. CAGE, AUDIT).

topics.label: Drug and substance use
topics.description: Cannabis and other drugs, solvents.

topics.label: Risk taking
topics.description: Risky behaviours not covered elsewhere, e.g. gambling.

topics.label: Sexual behaviour
topics.description: Sexual activity, partners, orientation and identity.

domains.label: Family and social networks
domains.description: The household, relationships and social life.

topics.label: Home life
topics.description: Family routines and activities at home, family functioning.

topics.label: Household composition
topics.description: Who lives in the household, household grids, household size.

topics.label: Partnership and marital status
topics.description: Marriage, cohabitation, partnership histories, separation and divorce.

topics.label: Family members and relations
topics.description: Parents, siblings, children, relationships with them, contact with non-resident family.

topics.label: Friends
topics.description: Friendships and peers.

topics.label: Childcare
topics.description: Childcare arrangements and costs.

topics.label: Child welfare
topics.description: Children in care, child protection, adversity in childhood.

topics.label: Social support
topics.description: Help and support given or received, caring for others.

topics.label: Leisure activities
topics.description: Hobbies, pastimes, reading, clubs, volunteering, media use.

topics.label: Social capital
topics.description: Civic participation, trust, community involvement.

topics.label: Technology
topics.description: Internet, computers, phones and their use.

topics.label: Qualifications
topics.description: Exams, qualifications held, highest qualification, grades.

topics.label: Further and higher education
topics.description: College, sixth form, university, courses after 16.

topics.label: Training
topics.description: Work-related and vocational training, apprenticeships.

topics.label: Basic skills
topics.description: Literacy and numeracy in adulthood.

topics.label: Adult education
topics.description: Education taken up in adulthood.

topics.label: Learning difficulties and SEN
topics.description: Special educational needs, dyslexia, learning difficulties.

topics.label: Pre-school
topics.description: Nursery, playgroup and early education.

topics.label: Cognitive skills and attainment
topics.description: School attainment and ability test scores (reading, maths, vocabulary).

topics.label: Non-cognitive skills
topics.description: Motivation, self-control, perseverance, social skills.

topics.label: School engagement
topics.description: Attitudes to school, attendance, truancy, exclusion, homework.

topics.label: Educational aspirations
topics.description: Plans and hopes for education, including parents' aspirations.

topics.label: Lifelong learning
topics.description: Continuing learning across adult life.

topics.label: Primary schooling
topics.description: Primary school, its type and characteristics.

topics.label: Secondary schooling
topics.description: Secondary school, its type and characteristics, school leaving.

topics.label: Occupation and employment
topics.description: Economic activity, jobs, hours, occupation codes, unemployment, activity histories.

topics.label: Social classification
topics.description: Social class, NS-SEC, socio-economic group, occupational status.

topics.label: Income
topics.description: Earnings, household income, unfolding income brackets.

topics.label: Finances
topics.description: Financial situation, debt, managing financially, savings behaviour, financial literacy.

topics.label: Assets
topics.description: Savings, investments, property wealth.

topics.label: Consumption and expenditure
topics.description: Spending and what is bought.

topics.label: Pensions
topics.description: Pension schemes and contributions.

topics.label: Benefits and welfare
topics.description: State benefits and tax credits received.

topics.label: Social attitudes
topics.description: Attitudes to society, gender roles, work, the future.

topics.label: Politics
topics.description: Political interest, voting, party support.

topics.label: Infant feeding
topics.description: Breastfeeding, weaning, infant diet.

topics.label: Language and vocabulary
topics.description: Early language development and vocabulary.

topics.label: Parenting
topics.description: Parenting style, discipline, parental involvement and interest in the child.

topics.label: Developmental milestones
topics.description: Walking, talking, toilet training and other milestones.

domains.label: Life events
domains.description: Significant events across the life course.

topics.label: Retirement
topics.description: Retirement plans and timing.

topics.label: Crime and police contact
topics.description: Offending, arrests, police contact, victimisation by crime, antisocial behaviour.

topics.label: Bullying
topics.description: Being bullied or bullying others.

topics.label: Covid-19 pandemic
topics.description: Experiences of the pandemic and lockdowns, economic shocks since Covid-19.

topics.label: Adverse life events
topics.description: Bereavement, family breakdown, serious illness of others and other stressful events.

topics.label: Genetics and genomics
topics.description: Genetic data, DNA samples. (CLOSER 11302-11306 folded in.)

topics.label: Biomarkers
topics.description: Blood, saliva and other samples and what was measured from them.

domains.label: Pregnancy
domains.description: Pregnancy and birth, of the cohort member's mother or of the cohort member.

topics.label: Pregnancy
topics.description: Pregnancies, antenatal care, smoking or drinking in pregnancy, miscarriage.

topics.label: Childbirth
topics.description: Delivery, birth weight, gestation, complications at birth.

topics.label: Infant mortality
topics.description: Stillbirth, neonatal and infant death.

domains.label: Administration
domains.description: How the data were collected, rather than about the person.

topics.label: Identifiers and linkage
topics.description: Serial numbers, person and household identifiers, keys for linking records.

topics.label: Survey weights and design
topics.description: Weights, strata, clusters, sample design variables.

topics.label: Interview and fieldwork
topics.description: Interview dates, mode, interviewer checks, response and participation status, consent.

topics.label: Other
topics.description: Nothing else fits.
